plainText:
Madness!! Mother Lusamine! (Japanese: 狂気！！母なるルザミーネ！ Insane!! Mother Lusamine!) is the 30th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Mina arrives on Poni Island, where she finds an injured Guzma.
Wicke takes Mina to Exeggutor Island to train with the other Trial Captains.
Guzma is taken to a medical ward, where he explains what happened to him after being kidnapped.
Lusamine and her s try to capture .
Necrozma absorbs Lunala to become its form.
captures to use against Lusamine and nicknames it Drachma.
Sina and Dexio tell Samson Oak about the Reassembly Unit and their plan to use it on .
tries to capture Lusamine's with a Beast Ball, but refuses as it could potentially hurt Lusamine.
